newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan gives nod to second forex brokerage.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan gives nod to second forex brokerage.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said on Wednesday it has agreed to the formation of the island's second foreign exchange brokerage in order to expand the market and increase efficiency.
The central bank said in a statement that it has given permission to allow unidentified private interests to set up a preparatory office of the Yuan Ta foreign exchange brokerage.

The planned brokerage, expected to start operation by the end of 1997, would need to register paid-in capital of at least T$100 million and obtain operating licences from the economics and finance ministries, the statement said.
Deputy central bank governor Liang Cheng-chin said the private interests included individual and institutional investors, both foreign and domestic.
The brokerage would be allowed to conduct foreign currency trading, foreign currency interbank trading and currency swaps.
At present, Taipei Forex Inc is Taiwan's only foreign exchange brokerage.
